snippet.title: Nagai - Puzzle Platformer. Tu Juego A Juicio Jam
snippet.description:
Hey this is my first game made for a game game. Is a little game about the story of a couple in love, at the end of the world.

Will they be able to escape the planet before its destruction?

Download for windows:
https://dannygaray60.itch.io/nagai

Nagai is more than a game, it is a playable experience. It might not be so original, but I am happy with the result.
This is the game jam:

Tu juego a juicio Jam 2021 - itch.io (jam by Alva Majo).
https://itch.io/jam/tu-juego-a-juicio-jam-2021
